## What happened?

Describe the problem and the result you expected.

## How can we reproduce it?

List the steps, Tiffin version, operating system and relevant configuration choices.

## Diagnostic details

Paste relevant output from `tiffin doctor --offline` after removing private data. Do not include tokens, chat IDs, message bodies, health records or your data directory.
